A skyscraper is a tall, continuously habitable building having multiple floors. Modern sources currently define skyscrapers as being at least 100 metres or 150 metres in height, though there is no universally accepted definition.

[{"score": 1, "comment": "I bought this for my driving simulator city I am building - Los Injurus City for the simulator Beamng Drive.  I have a very spartan budget so this fit the bill - but I actually bought this because it not only was a good price but I really liked the look of it.  The scale is correct and it comes with things grouped into convenient sections so you can easily wrangle the not-too-bad UV's into what you need.  My needs require super-low draw-calls since our game-engine has DirectX 11 as a fall-back if Vulkan isn't supported, so I did spend a day or more wrangling UV's sewing everything up and duplicating orphan UV's with like-textures - thank-goodness for having paid for some scripts to speed that up.
That said, the way the UV's were laid out - despite not being sewn - makes things very easy to work with.  In all honesty I have seen much, much worse.
I had to make a few small adjustments to the model, just minor nit-picks as we say here, and add doors since you'll be seeing most of it from street level -  but I have those already so it's all good.  I will add an elevator shaft shortly also, but for most this building should be fine as-is unless you're running this on a direct-x 11 or older rendering engine.
Didn't find errors with this model, and did not find 'hidden' surfaces either.  Building is easy to manipulate again due to previously mentioned groups.
If you want this for a city scene outside of video games - this is GREAT - if you are going to run this in a game, be prepared to optimize it some.  I cannot even begin to complain for the price, however, and am very satisfied.  The two smaller low-rise structures can be moved independently and arranged as satellite buildings regardless if you wish to physically have them connected with the main structure or not.  That's a nice bonus.

description_text: Hello Everyone!Today I have made a model of a skyscraper that was inspired by the design of the PetroBangla Building in Bangladesh.This model will save you a lot of time if you are making a open world video-game!This model is great for just about anything from city renderings to video games and etc.I have made this using Blender 2.9 .The HDRI that I have used to render the building was provided by HDRI Haven. https://hdrihaven.com/I have included this model in various file formats including a .blend file for you to edit the model to your preferences.In the .blend file, I have assigned different parts of the building to different materials, so it is easier for you to customize the look and color of the building.This model has 31,659 vertices, 26,199 faces and 53,423 triangles.

Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 The present building was built between 1747 and 1751 with 3 ships with cane ceiling. Seven brick columns on each side separated the nave of the laterales.Entre 1832 and 1834 there were the first changes extending the ship and building the present facade in Italian neoclassical style, with two towers covered with majolica domes, designed by Catalan architect Juan Roque. In 1834 he acquired the rank of Metropolitan Cathedral. In 1940 there was another important change, changing the ceiling of the nave by one barrel vault. Inside the most interesting work is a bas-relief of Christ in marble by Pigalle, flattered by Juan Manuel de Rosas to Estanislao Lopez.

Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 The first vicar was Friar Anthony of Padua Teixeira, who prayed the first mass on a provisional chapel, used while building the Matrix, inaugurated on March 25, 1781. In it was buried the founder of Campinas, Francisco Barreto Leme, on April 13 1782. The Bento Quirino Square, with its headquarters, was the "Celulla Mater" around which was formed and developed Campinas, then a drovers crossing point that went towards Goiás. In 1807 it was decided to transfer the headquarters of the parish to another place, building up a new church, the current Cathedral of Our Lady. da Conceição, which was completed and opened in 1883. It was the "Young Mother". But the people did not accept the "Old Mother" stopped being parish. Thus they claimed to continue as a parish, which was accepted by the Bishop of São Paulo, which created then the "Old Mother Church", the Parish of Santa Cruz, on May 08, 1870. In 1938, the parish was made official as N . Sra. do Carmo. The Carmo Matrix was reformed several times, and in 1929 was demolished and completely rebuilt in its neo-Gothic style it has today. On 6 November 1974, the Carmelite Mother of Pope Paul VI received the title of Basilica. The installation of the Basilica took place on June 22 the Holy Year 1975. It is a very dear church by the people of Campinas is the "Old Mother Church", the first church in the city.

description_text: The OBERLÄNDER is a basic type of the Middle Rhine ship, which of 15th up to 18th century was used mainly on the distance between Mainz and Cologne. Its shape is adapted to the particular circumstances of the current path and its fairway. The floor plan has the shape of a trapezoid. The greatest width is in the ship's bottom, and in the rear , the width of the 1.5 to 2 times the width of the bow. The floor is completely flat and is pulled up in the stern to a huge hut, which is pointed at a height of 6-7 m and steep drops to the deck. The deck has from bow to stern the same width and is completely flat. It falls against the bow. It gives the impression of heaviness, but this is not true. Top and bottom form an angle of up to 10 degrees. The 6-7 m high mast pole is used exclusively for towing. The viability of the Oberlander likely 100 - 120 t have not been exceeded. The round window is flush with the top strake, so that no transition board is available. The form shall bear halfway up two gangways, which served as the site of the Boating Party. The sites of Oberlander  were mainly in Bonn Beuel , to a lesser extent in Mainz on the Vilzbacher shipyard. Often the ships were used one or two times, than demolished to gain the wood for house construction.

overview:
Lowpoly Edwardian style townhouse with basic features; good for use as background architecture or for lowpoly game design. Optional basement level (can be easily hidden). Textures include Colour and Bump, UVs unwrapped.
History
This structure is representitive of much middle-class housing found throughout Britain and her territories at around the turn of the 20th Century. This model specifically represents a simplistic, though accurate, attempt to replicate a specific building; Laurel Villa which was in found in Kent, England until the mid 1960s when it was demolished.

description_text:
After the release of several prototypes, the Muegyetemi Sportrepulo Egyesulet (MSrE) in 1938 began the construction of the first production aircraft based on the M-19, designated M-24. The main designers of the project were Josef Szegedy and Endre Jancsó.
The aircraft was a double low wing with an elliptical wing, equipped with a German engine Hirth HM 504A-2 with a capacity of 100 hp. (75 kW).
After a successful prototype test, a small series of 5 aircraft was ordered. The first two cars in this series were sold by the Royal Air Force of Egypt.
In 1940, a modification of the aircraft was released, which received the designation M-25 Nebulo. It was also built in a small series in triplicate.
In the same year, the EMESE experimental plant was erected, where they began to build prototypes developed at MSrE. In 1942, another modification of the M-24 was completed, which received the designation M-29. And a year later, the M-27 was built at the plant, which was a training modification for fighter pilots with the German Argus As 10 engine. These prototypes did not receive further development, since the plant was destroyed as a result of the Allied bombing.

description_text:
Brazier, fired with coke or coal
Often used for waste incineration or outdoor heating during severe winters.The size of this brazier is adapted to the original dimensions, 80 cm high, 50 cm inside diameter, 60 cm outside diameter.Additionally, textures for the normal, rough, bump layers are added to the object.
Feel free to download, I sell objects at a minimum price to be able to pay the costs associated with their listing.I also invite people who would like to create an object according to their needs to contact me.
The textures mostly at the resolution of 2048 x 2048
Some objects are packed in a zip, because they have the texture catalog structure preserved together with the object, which should facilitate working with the finished model.
The files are sometimes repeated because their versions were created using different methods, e.g. fbxs are created by exporting from the source program and to it separately basic textures, and the fbx version with built-in full PBR texturing built with the object.
Feel free to download, I sell objects at a minimum price to be able to pay the costs associated with their listing.I also invite people who would like to create an object according to their needs to contact me.

description_text:
Hello,Im representing you pack of historical clay pots.It contains 5 unique static meshes.
Models were made in Blender 2.8 and they are made from quads only for better game render.Textures are 1K resolution. Pivots set on bottom of objects.Models are available in following formats

  - Blend

  - Uasset

  - Fbx

  - Obj

  - Dae

  - Ply

  - Stl

  - abc

I use Unreal Engine 4 naming convention

  - SM – static mesh (SM_Hammer)

  - M – material (M_Wood)

  - T – texture (T_Metal)

Models are game ready, you can just drag fbx to content window in UE4 and it will create and assign materials (just click import all when importing).I am a fresh 3D artist so write to me if something is wrong.

description_text: The Dauytuly Shyngysbai kazhy mosque or the Zhami mosque is the spiritual heritage of the city and one of its oldest fundamental buildings, built in the middle of the 19th century. It is located in the old part of Shymkent city. In the first half of the twentieth century, from the time of the formation of Soviet power and until the end of World War II, the building of the mosque was used as a military barracks. In 1947, the mosque was handed over for the use of the people and was named Koshkar ata. From 1947 to 1997, the mosque was considered the central regional one. In 2000, the old name Koshkar Ata was changed to the modern one. The total area of ​​the mosque is 717.3 square meters. There are two minarets in the courtyard of the mosque, the height of which is 4.8 meters and 10 meters.

description_text:
Low-poly stylized stone obelisk model made in 3ds Max, sculpted in Blender, baked and textured in Substance Painter.
Model details: 

  - Model has 2853 polygons and 2850 vertices

  - Textures come in 2k resolution

  - Texture pack contains .png, .jpeg and .targa files for UE4 and png files for vray, corona, arnold and unity_hd_render_pipeline

  - Model pack includes .fbx, .max, .blend and .obj files

  - Model scale might be pretty small - it has to be rescaled in scene or game engine

  - Textures are not included into .fbx file and have to be plugged in manually

  - Everything is placed to 0.0.0 scene coordinates

  - Everything is named properly, all elements share same UV set

  - Nothing is overlapping, nothing is animated

As usual - best wishes and have a nice day!:D

description_text:
The history of Bukhara stretches back for millennia. The origin of its inhabitants goes back to the period of Aryan immigration into the region.[1] The city itself, currently the capital of the Bukhara Province (viloyat) of Uzbekistan, is about two and a half thousand years old. Located on the Silk Road, the city has long been a centre of trade, scholarship, culture, and religion. During the Golden age of Islam, under the rule of Samanids, Bukhara became the intellectual centre of the Islamic world. In medieval times, Bukhara served as the capital of the Khanate of Bukhara and was the birthplace of Imam Bukhari.
UNESCO has listed the historic centre of Bukhara, which contains numerous mosques and madrassas, as one of the World Heritage Sites.
Bukhara functioned as one of the main centres of Persian civilization from its early days in the 6th century BCE. The city's architectural and archaeological sites form one of the pillars of Central Asian history and art.[citation needed] The region of Bukhara long formed part of the Persian Empire.

description_text: This is an 1899 Mosley Folding bathtub ad. Mosley folding bathtubs where manufactured from 1880 to 1900 as a way to bathe without having all the space needed for a traditional bathtub. They were advertised as A perfectly equipped bath and No Bathroom required. The mosley folding bathtub produced 20 styles of bathtubs over the years. The one in this pictureis a type that looked like a stand-alone mirror when closed. I have a model of another mosley ad in my store that depicts a version that was similar except the mirror did not go down to the bottom and the unused space was taken up by fake decorative drawers. If you enjoy these models please give them a like, a good review, and visit my store where I have many similar models for sale. If you have any questions about this asset, or about anything in my store, please contact me. If you have any issues please do the same before leaving a bad review, because it may be a simple mistake that I can try to fix.

description_text: In Japan, a tōrō is a traditional lantern made of stone, wood, or metal. Like many other elements of Japanese traditional architecture, it originated in China where they can still be found in Buddhist temples and Chinese gardens. They are not as common in Korea as they are in China or Japan. In Japan, tōrō were originally used only in Buddhist temples, where they lined and illuminated paths. Lit lanterns were then considered an offering to Buddha. Their use in Shinto shrines and also private homes started during the Heian period (794–1185).

description_text:
This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 This is a modular tree house. It can be delievered on huge trucks as a payload and will just be hung up to a strong tree by a crane. Nine steel wires will hold it than.  This example is fixed to an european breech (fagus sylvatica) which has an maximum hight of 45m. Electric power is supplied by PV panels, hot water by solar energy. Waste water is filtered and will be used to water the tree.
this model was made for the Sketchup 3D challenge %232211. Please enjoy and rate!

description_text:
This is an industrial brick building.The model is perfect to use in the background of big scenes or inside of games as it is low-poly, but you can also use it for close-up shots.The building alone has around 2500 vertices and combining it with the rooftop decoration (which doesn't have to be used in your scene of course), the whole scene has around 56000 vertices.
You can easily change any window by shifting the texture around the model and you can place any light source in any of the rooms with windows. I chose to place the lights as they are seen in the preview images.
Note that this is only two sides of the building. You can easily expand it into having four sides but for most renders it isn't necessary and therefore saves vertices.
Downloading the .blend-file is recommended as the materials and textures will be perfectly projected onto the model other than using the .fbx- or the .obj-version.

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.

description_text:
This 3D model depicts a scene of an abandoned warehouse filled with various forgotten objects, creating a characteristic sense of decline and industrial neglect. On a sturdy wooden pallet, the following elements are arranged:
Rusty Barrels: Two metallic barrels covered in rust and stains that add realism and vintage charm. They can be used as storage or decorative elements.
Tires: Worn auto tires with dirty sides, once part of vehicles. They emphasize the theme of abandonment and create an atmosphere of fatigue.
Box: A simple yet intriguing box that raises questions about its fate. We can imagine it as a container for something important or just a forgotten item.
Canister: A dirty canister that might have contained something significant, now lost in the general timelessness of the warehouse.
This 3D model is perfect for themed games, animations, or visualizations aiming to create an ambiance of neglect and abandoned surroundings.

description_text: A castle is a type of fortified structure built during the Middle Ages predominantly by the nobility or royalty and by military orders. Scholars debate the scope of the word castle, but usually consider it to be the private fortified residence of a lord or noble. This is distinct from a palace, which is not fortified; from a fortress, which was not always a residence for royalty or nobility; and from a fortified settlement, which was a public defence – though there are many similarities among these types of construction. Usage of the term has varied over time and has been applied to structures as diverse as hill forts and country houses. Over the approximately 900 years that castles were built, they took on a great many forms with many different features, although some, such as curtain walls, arrowslits, and portcullises, were commonplace.

description_text:
The National Monument (Indonesian: Monumen Nasional, abbreviated Monas) is a 132 m (433 ft) tower in the centre of Merdeka Square, Central Jakarta, symbolizing the fight for Indonesia. It is the national monument of the Republic of Indonesia, built to commemorate the struggle for Indonesian independence.
Construction began in 1961 under the direction of President Sukarno. Monas was opened to the public in 1975. It is topped by a flame covered with gold foil.
The monument and the museum are open daily from 08.00 until 16.00 Western Indonesia Time (UTC+7) throughout the week except for the Mondays when the monument is closed. Since April 2016, the monument also opens during night time, from 19.00 until 22.00 in Tuesday to Friday, and from 19.00 until 00.00 in Saturday and Sunday.[1]

description_text: Dharahara, also called Bhimsen Tower, is a twenty two-storey, 61.88-metre-tall tower at the centre of Sundhara, Kathmandu, Nepal. It was first built in 1832 by Mukhtiyar Bhimsen Thapa under the commission of Queen Lalit Tripurasundari and was a part of the architecture of Kathmandu recognized by UNESCO.The 22-storey rebuilt tower will be inaugurated on April 24, on the eve of the day when the 7.6-magnititude earthquake had rattled the country in 2015.he original one, built by the first prime minister of Nepal Bhimsen Thapa, was destroyed in the 1934 earthquake. Rana Prime minister Juddha Sumsher Rana reconstructed it which was destroyed by the April 2015 earthquake. Under the coordination of the National Reconstruction Authority, the Reconstruction of the monument took place.The inauguration ceremony was organized on the eve of the sixth memorial day of the Gorkha earthquake which occurred on April 25, 2015. Reconstruction of the tower had begun in October 2018. Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli inaugurated the historical Bhimsensthmbha (Dharahara) on April 24, 2021 in Sundhara, Kathmandu.

About the model:

  - The water is a mesh, fixed. (Not animated.)

  - There are two textures sets: One for the ground and other for the Fountain itself. (Base, Roughness, and Normal maps).

  - There is the grass texture included too.

I hope you like it. :)

description_text: In this design, an attempt has been made to use the perspective of the existing contradiction to design the elements of urban furniture. The stillness and suspension of the two paradoxes form a concept that can attract the audience's senses and change the urban mood because what is less felt in our urban spaces today is the same kind of variety and charm that Fermi has. It can create curiosity and mental vitality for the citizens in a constructive and positive direction. The present design's elements are arranged to contrast with our ordinary ideas. Bases that do not seem to be connected and evoke a sense of suspense, chains that, despite the tensile role in the distribution of forces, seemingly play the role of compressive forces, creating a degree of continuity while separating the elements and in a nutshell Creating a new concept of stasis that in its expression reveals a manifestation of geometric instability. It is essential to create a different definition of urban furniture elements in terms of structural expression while maintaining regular use. Creating another presentation from the static one, which at first glance reveals a kind of suspension in space, creates a pleasant mental effect on the citizens. It is worth mentioning that the strength and efficiency of this design have been thoroughly evaluated and do not include any problems due to the lack of a functional purpose in urban furniture as well as damage from the perspective of the impact of vandalism.

The outermost curve circle controls the overall transformation of all objects.
This file retains historical records and does not collapse. The 3D font is easily adjusted.
For UV snapshot, please refer to Preview images on this page.

Maya default renderer: arnold 5.2.1.1.

A set of 6 rocks scanned from real life, all sharing a single texture set of Albedo, AO, Spec-Gloss(PBR) and Normal Map.
You can scale the rocks anywhere between 0.1 and 2.0x in scale for their textures to still hold, additional textures can be overlaid such as a detail mask of moss or more roughness.

All of the rocks are very low poly less than 200 polys per rock.

Extra textures supplied as to get more variation.

description_text:
Compatibility
This is a Bush Plant made for Blender(Cycles-eevee) and Maya (v-ray). It comes with three different variations for each renderer so that your scene doesn't look repetitive.
Polycount
The polygon count is the lowest possible without giving up the quality of a high quality render.  Each  leaf has got 5 vertices, 3 tris. The total polygon count in average of each bush variation is of around 145k tris.
How to use
  - Maya:
All you have to do in maya is to put the maya-version folder in your project folder, and in your scene go to: File>Import and select the .ma version of the desired variation and the model will be placed in your scene with the shaders working correctly, all you have to do than is position it
  - Blender:
All you have to do in blender is to go to File>Append, double click the  .blend file of the variation you want, then open Object folder, and select all the three files inside of it. All you have to do then is position it in your scene, it will be imported with all the shaders ready to go.

description_text:
This is a ground of a Brown and Grey RockTexture, it has been made with Materialize, the textures are in 4096x4096 png files, it is seamless and PBR.
Preview images are screenshot of the material in Materialize.
In the uploaded files, you will find a 3D file where the texture is applied to a plan scaled at 5 with a PBR node, the available formats for it are : .blend, .abc, .dae, .fbx, .glb, .obj, .mtl, .ply, .stl and .x3d. The native is blender so it is in cycles, you ca find the complete node tree in the shader editor. In Blender you just have to shift in the Render Mode to see the displacement of the texture.
Then you will find a .zip file wher are compressed the folowing textures : diffuse, ao, normal, height, metallic, roughness, smoothness and edge. All the texture are not especially necessary to build the texture but I uploaded it anyway in case you would need it. You will find in the .zip file a .mtz load file, if you get Materialize, you can load a project and select this .mtz file to open all the textures in the software.
I am at your disposal if you have any question.
Thanks, enjoy !

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 14
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 47
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

A crystal or crystalline solid is a solid material whose constituents (such as atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in a highly ordered microscopic structure, forming a crystal lattice that extends in all directions. In addition, macroscopic single crystals are usually identifiable by their geometrical shape, consisting of flat faces with specific, characteristic orientations. The scientific study of crystals and crystal formation is known as crystallography. The process of crystal formation via mechanisms of crystal growth is called crystallization or solidification.
The word crystal derives from the Ancient Greek word κρύσταλλος (krustallos), meaning both ice and rock crystal, from κρύος (kruos), icy cold, frost.
Examples of large crystals include snowflakes, diamonds, and table salt. Most inorganic solids are not crystals but polycrystals, i.e. many microscopic crystals fused together into a single solid. Examples of polycrystals include most metals, rocks, ceramics, and ice. A third category of solids is amorphous solids, where the atoms have no periodic structure whatsoever. Examples of amorphous solids include glass, wax, and many plastics.
Despite the name, lead crystal, crystal glass, and related products are not crystals, but rather types of glass, i.e. amorphous solids.
Crystals are often used in pseudoscientific practices such as crystal therapy, and, along with gemstones, are sometimes associated with spellwork in Wiccan beliefs and related religious movements.

This is a Cyan, Dark Blue, Purple and Pink Extraterrestrial Ground Texture, it has been made with Materialize, the textures are in 4096x4096 png files, it is seamless and PBR.
The preview images are screenshot of the material in Materialize, the first one has been made in Blender Cycles Render.
In the uploaded files, you will find a 3D file where the texture is applied to a plan scaled at 2 with a PBR node. You will find in the .zip file a .mtz load file, if you get Materialize, you can load a project and select this .mtz file to open all the textures in the software.
I am at your disposal if you have any question.
Thanks !

Later the construction of a new building begins at the intersection of Maipú and San Juan streets in the form of 15-story tower with 30 apartments and three local, completed in 1943 was one of the first high-rise buildings of the city and 1986 was expanded with the construction of a confectionery. The designers were Picasso Tower, Fernandez Days and Funes. The construction company was to Muniagurria, Arroyo and Spillet, the front, the balconies of the first 6 floors and the hall are clad in travertine marble and the doors are of polished cedar. Maglev routes are mostly on land and traverse the oceans only to the shortest routes. On the USA- Europe route, for example, the longest water transverse end section is only about 500 Km long. Energy is supplied enviroment- friendly by waterpowered sea flow power plants every 450m.The magnetic levitation drive automatically. description_text:
A LowPoly trade tent with easily removable objects from the tent itself.
Easily importable to Unity or any other game engine etc. with the materials on them. Easily switch materials (may be duplicates if added to game engines, but that's an easy fix), and also if you don't want the bottles or any other object on the table, you can easily remove the child objects of the tent (which is the parent object), for example I have added a picture what it looks like in Unity, easily move, remove or duplicate/edit the parts you want, add more barrels or remove them etc.
Tent itself is 1062 verts. and 1059 faces
Barrel: 182 verts., 171 faces (total of 11 barrels, 2 under the tent desk and rest beside the tent)
Chest: 290 verts., 270 faces (total of 3 chests, one smaller on the table, one larger under  table, and one open with 2 bottles inside (bottles give extra verts/faces).
Bottle: 110 verts. 102 faces. (total of 20 bottles not counting the ones inside the chest which are joined to that chest-object)
Shield = 512 verts. 482 faces (total of 6 shields)
Axe = 134 verts, 120 faces

The 3D  fire hydrant model was created on real base. It's created accurately, in  real units of measurement, qualitatively and maximally close to the  original.

Model formats:
- *.max (3ds Max)
- *.fbx (Multi Format)
- *.obj (Multi Format)
- *.3ds (Multi Format)
- *.blend (Blender 2.79)
- *.c4d (Cinema 4D 17)
* renders Are made in Cinema 4D R17
If you need any other formats we are more than happy to make them for you.

The  model is provided combined, all main parts are presented as separate  parts therefore materials of objects are easy to be modified or removed  and standard parts are easy to be replaced. If you experience  difficulties with separating standard parts we are more than happy to  give you qualified assistance. Thank you for picking interest in my  models. 
The archive texture folder is included.

description_text:
A kerosene lamp is a type of lighting device that uses kerosene as a fuel. Invented by the Polish pharmacist Ignacy Łukasiewicz in 1853, kerosene lamps have a wick or mantle as light source, protected by a glass chimney or globe; lamps may be used on a table, or hand-held lanterns may be used for portable lighting. Like oil lamps, they are useful for lighting without electricity, such as in regions without rural electrification, in electrified areas during power outages, at campsites, and on boats. There are three types of kerosene lamp: flat-wick, central-draught (tubular round wick), and mantle lamp. Kerosene lanterns meant for portable use have a flat wick and are made in dead-flame, hot-blast, and cold-blast variants.

History
The Golden Gate (in Spanish, Golden Door) is a suspension bridge located in California, the United States, that unites the peninsula of San Francisco by the north with the south of the county of Marin, near Sausalito. Golden Gate is also the name of the strait in which the bridge is built, and gets its name from the Strait in Constantinople, also called the Golden Gate, as it communicated Europe with Asia.
The Golden Gate is the most famous bridge in San Francisco despite not being the largest in this city, since the Bay Bridge is the main road.

description_text:
A simple and low-poly Indian Letter Box for any street envirtonment, perfect as a decor item. The renders in the preview were produced by Keyshot . The preview images also contains wireframe images alongside few images and non-edited textured images directly taken from Maya's viewport. 
Since both of the core models are same, their UV's are overlapped in order to save UV space and give both of them greater texel density.  To keep things lightweight, all the details are fused in a single diffuse texture map. 
Due to the low poly nature, they can be used in mobile games as well as any simulation.
**Note: Materials are not provided and textures are not embedded. The model only has a default material from Maya, it would be best if you could attach your own material and apply the provided texture image for best results. **
If you have any queries or require any form of assistance, feel free to give me a message (:
